g.text: Scope of the existing FinnGen R13 comparison
15 unique Graves regions and 16 unique AIHT regions
42 pairwise comparisons of detected association components
Five grouped class-count bars in each non-HLA region pair
42 comparisons: 8 strong H4 · 11 strong H3 · 1 suggestive H4 · 17 low purity · 5 low overlap.
